items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: And Bob Carr's quite a guy. And we ran the thing seven nights a week... Bob Carr says, 'Well, right now we can go in any one of these major hotels downtown...'

ctx.x: -- former governor of Colorado. And Bob Carr's quite a guy. And we ran the thing seven nights a week, and it's a haven for musicians that would come into town, like Stan Kenton and his great band. In fact, Stan was here; the night of
his birthday we gave him a big birthday party in this club. This club, incidentally, was formerly the old Arthur Murray --
